summary: Donetick is a self-hosted Go (Gin+GORM/SQLite|Postgres) family chores-and-tasks app: users, circles with admin/member/manager roles, recurring chores with frequencies, assignees, timer sessions, subtasks, labels/projects/filters, points, notifications (telegram/pushover/discord/FCM/webhook), things with state-triggered chores, file attachments with storage-quota, offline sync (cursors/tombstones), and Stripe/RevenueCat subscriptions.
